coder_notes: Phase NA imaging study predicting response to clinically indicated bevacizumab. Bevacizumab is not a registered intervention but every patient receives it as routine care, so listed as soc_backbone (not investigated in a new schedule). Registered intervention 'FDG PET' text describes IV 18F-DOPA (F Dopa) while title/summary say 18F-FDG; coded as fludeoxyglucose, flag for moiety check. FDG PET/CT perfusion parameters are imaging markers, not molecular biomarkers.
